text:
maya (PM): quick sync — prioritization ask for private deploy roadmap. customers keep pushing for two things: stable egress IPs and a slim installer. need callouts for launch criteria and what we can promise w/ current infra

raj (Eng): agree on egress IPs. main risk is upgrades. if operator changes CNI we lose IP preservation.

owen (Infra): can do UID-based mapping + controller that rebinds IP on pod recreate, but not across major operator rewrites. need a doced fallback.

noah (Security): also need to lock down telemetry options and KMS proof paths. customers want attestable key residency for private.

lina (Solutions): field asks: 1) offline package signing, 2) explicit allowed-egress CIDR list in UI, 3) installer mode that doesn't require outbound to redwood.com.

maya (PM): good list. propose MVP launch criteria: - egress IP persistence within a minor upgrade window - installer slim-mode (no outbound) for install only - telemetry opt-in w/ local log export - KMS integration stub + contract for HSM. yay/nay?

raj (Eng): +1 for those criteria. dev note: "egress persistence" will be best-effort across operator upgrades unless we ship an operator-shim. shipping shim upsizes scope.

tess (Eng-Ops): shim approach would be: operator-shim manages IP handles, exposes heartbeat API, and coordinates drain+rebind during upgrades. we can prototype in Q2.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: private-prototype/shim-proto -> canary on staging at 2025-05-12T03:00Z :rocket:

maya (PM): field constraints: several enterprise customers need 4-hour rollback window and deterministic fallbacks if IP rebinding fails. can we meet that SLA?

owen (Infra): 4-hour rollback window is tough for major migrations; for minor patches yes. we should surface a customer-tiered SLA: silver/gold levels.

sophia (Field): customers will accept tiered SLAs if we provide a clear opt-in contract and runbooks. they want an explicit failure modal + network fallback plan.

noah (Security): legal will need telemetry and signing language. offline package signing + checksums + pinned signing key. add a manual attestation step for air-gapped installs.

lina (Solutions): here's a small installer snippet customers asked for (config to disable outbound calls):
```yaml
installer:
  offline_mode: true
  allowlist_cidrs:
    - 10.0.0.0/8
    - 192.168.0.0/16
  telemetry: opt_in
```

raj (Eng): thanks. action items I see: 1) prototype operator-shim (tess+raj) 2) implement offline-installer flags (raj+owen) 3) KMS integration contract draft (noah+lina) 4) SLA tiers + rollback doc (maya+owen+sophia)

maya (PM): timeline proposal: prototype shim + offline installer by end of Q2, SLA doc + KMS contract draft by mid-Q3. can we commit?

tess (Eng-Ops): prototype commit: yes for Q2. scope: POC shim, docs, and e2e test for minor upgrade path.

nowah (typo?)

noah (Security): mid-Q3 for KMS contract draft ok. need to loop in legal early.

lina (Solutions): i'll line up two customers for the field pilot (one cloud-native, one air-gapped).

maya (PM): cool. next steps: - raj/tess: PR with shim design by 2025-04-18 - raj/owen: installer flags PR by 2025-04-25 - noah/lina: KMS requirements draft by 2025-05-02 - maya: assemble SLA baseline and circulation by 2025-05-09

raj (Eng): will post an initial design doc here: https://redwood.team/rfcs/shim-proto — feedback welcome

sophia (Field): :thumbsup: i'll prep field playbook snippets for the pilot.

owen (Infra): flag: we should measure expected token-serving perf delta for shim approach (likely <2% but need numbers). will add perf tests to canary.

maya (PM): perfect. thanks all. will update roadmap sheet and ping legal. if anyone hits blockers ping me or drop in #eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: jira created: RED-3456 "operator-shim prototype" assigned to raj (Eng)

raj (Eng): thanks — will follow up w/ short tech note and a link to the test plan."
